effect_description_eng:
You may digivolve this card from your hand onto one of your green Tamers as if the Tamer is a level 3 green Digimon for a memory cost of 2.
[When Digivolving] If a card with the [Hybrid] trait or [J.P. Shibayama] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less.
